annotations.title: List the firms red-listed on one import alert

description: Who is on this import alert? Returns the firms red-listed on one alert number (from list_import_alerts), newest listing first, optionally narrowed to a country — for example every Vietnamese firm on 16-120, or every firm on 66-57. Each with the FDA page and a verbatim quote. Screening one supplier and would otherwise call several registers by hand? `screen_firm` at referencesource.org/mcp/screen answers this register and three others in one call.

import_alert_number.description: The alert number as FDA prints it, e.g. "16-120" or "66-57".

name: list_alert_firms

also_reported.description: Values for this record reported by a SECOND source, each with its own source_url and source_quote. Cite these to the page they name, never to the record's primary source.

firm_name.description: As the red list prints it.

record_url.description: This record's own page on referencesource.org.

source_quote.description: Verbatim text from that page containing the value.

source_url.description: The page the value was read from.

title: List the firms red-listed on one import alert
